# CyberConnect

CyberConnect is CyberCube's API layer for integrating its cyber risk models, analytics and signals into a customer's own systems. CyberCube advertises API capabilities across catastrophe risk management, risk scoring analysis, financial loss modeling, reinsurance modeling, SPoF intelligence, risk intelligence and threat modeling, supporting portfolio risk management, single-risk underwriting and transaction broking workflows. No machine-readable contract (OpenAPI, AsyncAPI or GraphQL) is published on any public host; the API reference is inside the login-gated Atlas documentation portal.

[Documentation](https://www.cybcube.com/cyberconnect) [GitHub](https://github.com/api-evangelist/cybercube)

#### Call it yourself

curl for this page

This API

```
curl "https://apis.io/api/v1/apis/cybercube:cyberconnect"
```

All apis

```
curl "https://apis.io/api/v1/apis?limit=25"
```

Calls without `X-API-Key` need no key. Calls with it need a paid plan — [get a key](https://apis.io/developer/account/?access=1).
